Exploit the potential of Multi-column architecture for Crowd Counting [paper

repo_info.description: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to explicitly address feature similarity issue in multi-column design. Extensive experiments on four challenging benchmarks (ShanghaiTech, UCF_CC_50, UCF-QNRF, and Mall) demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed innovations as well as the superior performance over the state-of-the-art. More remarkably, our method can be easily applied to other existing multi-column models as a plug-in to significantly boost the performance to a large extent.

children.title: [Switching CNN] Switching Convolutional Neural Network for Crowd Counting (CVPR) [paper

repo_info.description: This project is an implementation of the crowd counting model proposed in our CVPR 2017 paper - Switching Convolutional Neural Network(SCNN) for Crowd Counting. SCNN is an adaptation of the fully-convolutional neural network  and uses an expert CNN that chooses the best crowd density CNN regressor for parts of the scene from a bag of regressors. This helps it tackle intra-scene crowd density variation and obtain SOTA results
